items: RIVMOUNT winter gloves with touchscreen, 3 M insulation, waterproof, windproof, lightweight and anti-slip.
New upgraded Rivmount Winter Gloves, More 3M Thinsulate insulation, more warmth! Meet waterproof, windproof, touchscreen and anti-slip functions. Perfect as a winter gift for family and friends.

【Soft Warm with 3 M Insulation】 The Gloves are crafted with 7-layers of insulation material to ensure warmth in cold weather, which feature 3 M insulation, ensuring warmth on snowy day. The linings are made of soft & skin-friendly fluffy, providing warmth and comfort. TIP: In extremely cold conditions or sub-freezing temperatures for extended periods, please choose more professional-grade gloves!

【Waterproof & Windproof】 These warm glove features a multi-layer waterproof material design. The outshells are crafted with waterproof fabric. Inside, double-layer waterproof and windproof TPU inserts provide multiple layers of protection. And the elastic cuff stably hold the gloves in place, effectively keeping out cold wind and snow. TIP: Not recommended for full immersion in water!

【Touchscreen & Non-slip】 The full palm of snow gloves is made from PU conductive leather, offering sensitivity for touch screen and anti-slip grip. You can operate electronic screens without removing the gloves, ensuring convenience and efficiency. TIP: For optimal touch experience, please use after unlocking the phone.

【Humanized Detail Design】 The reflective strip on the back enhances safety during cycling, running, or walking at night. The anti-lost buckle makes the gloves easy to carry while reducing the risk of losing. The insulated gloves also feature hidden internal seams and widened finger spaces, making them more durability & stylish.

【Multiple Use】 RIVMOUNT winter gloves are ideal festive gifts for family and friends. These unisex thermal gloves are suit for multiple outdoor and indoor scenarios, also suit for use in all seasons. They are perfect for cold weather running, cycling, hiking, skiing, snowboarding, daily use, working, commuting, snowmobile, driving, shovel snow, travel, camping, hunting, equestrian etc.
